title: Urban Air Quality Molecular Analyzer
description: A virtual city sits on a lab bench as a miniature pollution model. The user operates a BoomBox-shaped molecular spectrometer to scan different city zones, identify airborne chemical compounds, calibrate detection thresholds, and synthesize a neutralizing reagent to clean the city's atmosphere in real time.
prompt: Create a single HTML file using Three.js r170 with GLTFLoader and OrbitControls from CDN. Scene: A chemistry lab bench environment with a dark surface and soft ambient lighting (hemisphere light warm/cool, plus two directional lights). Load VirtualCity.glb scaled to roughly 0.3 units, placed center-left on the bench as a miniature city pollution model. Load BoomBox.glb scaled to about 3.0 units, placed to the right as a molecular spectrometer instrument. Add a translucent dome (SphereGeometry, MeshPhysicalMaterial with transmission 0.4, color tinted yellow-brown) over the city representing smog. Camera starts at position (0, 3, 5) looking at center. Interaction steps: (1) User clicks the BoomBox to power it on, triggering a glow animation on its mesh using emissive color ramp. (2) A floating UI panel appears with 5 city zones highlighted as clickable hotspots (colored spheres) above different parts of the VirtualCity model. (3) User clicks each zone sequentially; each click triggers a visible scan beam (a RayCaster-visualized line with a cylinder geometry, green emissive) from the BoomBox to that zone. (4) Each scan reveals a compound label (CO2, NO2, SO2, O3, PM2.5) in a CSS2DRenderer overlay near that zone. (5) After all 5 zones are scanned, a calibration slider appears in an HTML overlay. User must drag the slider to set detection threshold between 50-150 ppm; validate the value is in range. (6) User clicks a Synthesize button; animate particles (small spheres with random velocity) flowing from the BoomBox toward the city dome. (7) The smog dome gradually transitions from yellow-brown to fully transparent over 2 seconds using a TWEEN or requestAnimationFrame lerp on opacity and color. (8) Display a final results panel showing each compound and its neutralized status. Track completion state for all 8 steps and show a progress bar. Add parameter validation ensuring the calibration value is numeric and within the valid range before allowing synthesis. Use OrbitControls with damping enabled.
